role_partial_definition: This role could not be measured for {dimensions}, so its score is not comparable with players scored from the full definition.
role_definition_unmeasurable: Too little of this role's definition could be measured.
role_population_too_small: Too few players were evaluated for this role to place a score among them.
no_role_defined_for_position: No role is defined for this position group, so there is nothing to score this profile against.
no_role_reached_coverage: No role reached the metric coverage it requires. The closest was {role}, which was measurable to {coverage_pct}% of its definition against the {required_pct}% it needs. The player is unchanged and every metric they do carry is below; what is missing is provider data, not performance.
low_evidence_title: Below {threshold} {noun}, this is reported but not offered as one of the player's strongest dimensions. The percentile is unchanged.
score_unavailable_missing: {score} needs {metrics}, which the performance provider does not supply. No amount of widening the filters will produce it.
score_unavailable_no_candidate: {score} could not be computed for any candidate in this search.
coverage_explanation: The share of played minutes the detailed statistics cover. Below full coverage, a per-90 is computed from the minutes that were recorded, not from every minute played.
minutes_discrepancy_label: The provider's two minute figures disagree
minutes_discrepancy_explanation: Played minutes and recorded minutes come from different fields and do not match for this player. Per-90 figures are computed from the one each metric is actually divided by, and the difference is shown rather than resolved.
role_coverage_explanation: Share of this role's configured weight backed by metrics the provider supplies. The missing components are not counted as zero; the weights of what remains are rescaled, and this figure is how much of the definition was behind the score.
demo_mode: Demo mode: all player names and statistics shown are fabricated sample data generated for testing. They do not describe real footballers.
opportunity_disclaimer: These players meet the criteria you set. They are not identified as undervalued: no valuation model is applied, and market value is a crowd-sourced estimate rather than a transfer fee.
role_aligns: The statistical profile aligns best with a {role} role: {standing} against others evaluated for the same role.
role_aligns_with_drivers: The statistical profile aligns best with a {role} role, driven mainly by {drivers}: {standing} against others evaluated for the same role.
role_limited_claim: Scores as a {role} on the part of that definition the data covers - {standing} against others evaluated for the same role.
role_limited_claim_with_drivers: Scores as a {role} on the part of that definition the data covers, driven mainly by {drivers} - {standing} against others evaluated for the same role.
role_aligns_no_population: The statistical profile aligns best with a {role} role. Too few comparable players to place that score among others.
role_aligns_no_population_with_drivers: The statistical profile aligns best with a {role} role, driven mainly by {drivers}. Too few comparable players to place that score among others.
set_aside_scores: Scoring high but on too little to call a strength: {scores}.
confidence_coverage_high: The provider describes {pct}% of those minutes in detail, so the per-90 figures above rest on most of the football played.
confidence_coverage_mid: The provider describes {pct}% of those minutes in detail. Rates built from that feed cover about half the football played.
confidence_coverage_low: The provider describes only {pct}% of those minutes in detail. Treat the detailed rates as limited evidence.
confidence_coverage_unknown: How much of these minutes the provider described in detail is unknown.
not_ranked_here: Not ranked here because the provider does not supply them: {metrics}.
not_ranked_here_more: Not ranked here because the provider does not supply them: {metrics}, and {more} more.
role_computed_without: The {role} score was computed without {metrics}. The remaining weights were renormalised, so the score is not lowered by the absence - but it describes less of the role than the name suggests.
not_captured_1: Tactical role and responsibilities as observed on video
not_captured_2: Physical qualities the provider does not record
not_captured_4: Temperament, and how a player handles a dressing room
not_captured_5: Wage demands, agent terms and whether the club would sell
not_captured_6: How well the player would adapt to a different league or system
recruitment_partial_ranking: {missing} of the {requested} requested scores could not be produced, so this ranking uses the rest.
recruitment_none_scored: {considered} players matched the filters, but none could be given every requested score — usually too few comparable players in their competition and position to rank against.
recruitment_blocked_scores: No player could be ranked: {scores} cannot be produced from the loaded data. Every candidate needs all of the requested scores, so a profile weighting one that does not exist matches nobody. Removing it from the profile will help; narrowing the filters will not.
ranking_shrunk: Ranked at {ranked} rather than {raw}: with {minutes} minutes, this {ranked_noun} carries {pct}% of a full season's evidence, so it is read closer to the average {centre} ({mean}) than a full season would be. The {ranked_noun} itself is unchanged.
ranking_shrunk_no_minutes: Ranked at {ranked} rather than {raw}: with no recorded minutes, this {ranked_noun} carries {pct}% of a full season's evidence, so it is read closer to the average {centre} ({mean}) than a full season would be. The {ranked_noun} itself is unchanged.
provider_notes_footystats: {usable} of {total} canonical metrics usable: {native} supplied as fields and {derived} derived from fields that are. Unavailable: {metrics}. Position group is supplied only for goalkeepers; the provider's four-value position vocabulary cannot determine the others.
provider_notes_transfermarkt: Public dataset snapshot. Transfer type and secondary nationality are not carried by this source and are left unset.
provider_notes_demo: Fabricated demonstration data. Players, clubs and competitions are invented and no figure describes a real performance.
market_notes_serving: Serving {valued} current valuations, {valuations} historical valuations and {transfers} transfers; {contracts} players carry a contract expiry. Counted from the database behind the pages, not from an ingestion snapshot.
market_notes_none_served: No market data is being served, and no snapshot is available to load one.
market_notes_snapshot_not_served: A snapshot is readable but no market rows are being served: the pages that need them will be empty.
health_database_unreachable: Could not establish a database connection.
health_database_unmigrated: Database reachable but migrations have not been applied.
health_footystats_no_key_demo: No API key supplied. Mock performance data in use.
health_footystats_no_key: No API key supplied. Production performance data is unavailable.
health_footystats_unprofiled: API key present, but no field has been verified against a real API response. Run the profiling pipeline.
health_footystats_ok: {usable} of {total} canonical metrics usable: {native} supplied as fields, {derived} derived from fields that are, {unavailable} unavailable. Verified against real responses; not contacted by this check.
health_analytics_empty: No player data is loaded. Run the ingestion pipeline; until then search, profiles and rankings have nothing to serve.
health_analytics_stale: Serving {seasons} player-seasons built at {built}. The database has been loaded since; restart the API to serve the new data.
health_analytics_ok_excluded: {seasons} player-seasons across {competitions} competitions, built at {built}. {excluded} excluded for having no position group.
screen_thin_result: {found} of {started} players cleared every criterion. Most were removed by “{criterion}” ({removed} players); {survived} survived the full screen.
load_never_recorded: No load has ever recorded a quality check.
no_rows: There are no rows to check.
metrics_absent: The provider supplies no usable value for {metrics}.
features_disabled: {derived_count} derived metrics, {score_count} intelligence scores and {role_count} roles cannot be computed.
position_group_unmapped: {share} of players have no position group.
demo_mixed_with_real: Generated data is loaded alongside {sources}; similarity would suggest invented players to real ones.
facts_from_a_dead_source: {sources} has rows here and no player mappings, which is what a refresh that purged half of itself leaves behind.
duplicate_same_source_valuation: Several dates for one player is a history, not a duplicate; this counts one source claiming one player on one date twice.
recorded_minutes_exceed_played: {share} of player-seasons report more detailed recorded minutes than minutes played. Provider values are preserved; per-90 figures follow the validated denominator per metric family.
competition_reference_cleared: Clubs referencing a competition outside the covered set; the reference was cleared rather than the club dropped.
club_reference_cleared: Players whose current club is outside the covered set; the reference was cleared rather than the player dropped.
thin_competitions: Competitions with fewer than {minimum} players, which usually means a partial extract rather than a small league.
no_rows_refused: Every row the providers supplied was accepted by the database.
rows_refused_by_a_constraint: {rows} rows the providers supplied were refused by the database and are not included: {constraints}.
absent:progressive_passes: {field} exists as a key and is null in all {sampled} sampled records. It is {share_of_score}% of the {score} score, which is why its absence is the most expensive of the three.
absent:aerial_duels: Only {supplied} is supplied. The attempt count is absent, and {percentage_field} - which would allow deriving it - returns 0 for every sampled record. The key {missing_field} never appears at all.
absent:successful_tackles: {field} is declared and never populated: non-null in 0 of the {sampled} sampled records that carry the key. {not_a_substitute} is supplied and is NOT a substitute - attempts and successes are different measurements, and swapping one for the other would change what every score built on it means.
